Subject: Batch window latency anomalies — observed 02:00–04:00 PST

Team,

We saw sustained p95 latency spikes and a ~30% throughput drop in the nightly batch window (02:00–04:00 PST) starting 03/15 02:20. p50 and avg look normal; the anomaly correlates with increased worker CPU contention on the gen-api nodes and a spike in KV cache misses. Attached initial service logs and a heap snapshot for the most affected host.

Immediate asks:
- SRE: can we schedule a focused canary (small traffic redirect) into the staging canary pool tonight at 03:00 and run the smaller-batch-size config (batch_size=8) to validate impact?
- Product: need decision on whether to temporarily enable the lower-latency model variant (quantized-v2) for BrightCart during the window. This has a known 8–12% quality delta but improves latency.
- CS: Marissa, please prep a short customer note if we decide to run the canary and what the fallback will be.

I copied Alex from BrightCart so he has visibility; Marissa / Ben, flag if we need legal or pricing sign-off for any credits.

Karthik
Senior PM, Redwood Inference

Attachments: service-logs-20260316.tar.gz (logs), heap_snapshot.png (heap dump preview)

Date: 2026-03-16T09:38:00-07:00
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Alex Hsu <alex.hsu@brightcart.com>
Subject: Re: Batch window latency anomalies — observed 02:00–04:00 PST

Thanks Karthik — investigating. Quick notes from SRE triage:
- Cause (prelim): periodic GC churn + one autoscaler flapping that temporarily oversubscribed CPU on the gen-api group. KV cache miss rate increased ~6x at spike start.
- Short-term mitigation (can be applied tonight):
  * Canary plan at 03:00 PST — route 10% of batch traffic for BrightCart to staging canary pool (will be isolated).
  * Apply reduced batch_size=8 and disable expensive post-processing step X for canary traffic.
  * If latency drops to acceptable range, we can roll the config to prod with staged ramp and a 1-hour watch.
- Risks: quantized-v2 reduces latency but may cause a small regression on rare prompts (we have eval set numbers).

I will post an INF ticket with exact playbook and automated rollback triggers. Need Marissa to confirm customer comm timing — we should notify BrightCart before the canary if we change model variant.

Soojin
Principal SRE

Attachments: INF-2345-runbook (link in thread)
